When old Mrs. Tess of Iron Cross Street in the Lower Street sewed this doll, her fingers were already crooked and deformed. 
 A black court dress, deep eyes, tightly pursed lipsвЂ”she poured all her remaining craftsmanship into it, yet no one knew why she had made it so exquisite. 
 "How much?" a gentleman asked. 
 "Trade it for a bottle of hemlock juice," the old lady said. 
 The transaction was completed. That night, old Mrs. Tess and her critically ill husband drank the poison together, closing their eyes with a smile of relief. 
 Three days later, the gentleman was hit by a carriage on the street. 
 A week later, his wife fell suddenly ill. 
 Two weeks later, his shop caught fire. 
 When the Nighthawks found him, the gentleman was already insane, clutching the doll tightly and muttering: "It's her... she sewed all the misfortune into it..." 
 On the hem of the doll's dress, the stains were vaguely in the shape of tears.

The time points for declaring war are: <Highlight>Monday to Thursday 12:00-14:00, 20:00-23:00; Friday 12:00-14:00, 21:00-23:00; Saturday to Sunday 12:00-18:00, 22:00-23:00</>. 3. Initiating a war declaration will consume Club Funds, which are deducted based on the club's level, strength difference, and Blood Feud value. 4. If the declaring party wins, <Highlight>30%</> of the Club Funds will be refunded; if they lose, they will not be refunded. If the declared party loses, corresponding funds will be deducted based on the club's level; if they win, no funds will be deducted. 5. If you continuously declare war on the same club and win, the Club Funds consumed for declaring war again will increase <Highlight>(resets at 8:00 every Monday)</>. 6. If you are continuously declared war on by the same club and lose, the Club Funds consumed for being declared war on again will decrease <Highlight>(resets at 8:00 every Monday)</>. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Gameplay Introduction</> 1. Club war declaration will take place in the Hornacis Mountain Range open world map for free combat. After the war declaration begins, only the two parties who declared war on each other will enter a duel state. 2. Plant Flag: The initiating party first obtains the right to plant the flag. After any one of the <Highlight>(President, Vice President, Director)</> plants the flag, the club's flag-planting skill will disappear. After planting the flag, you will gain points based on the survival time around the flag. 3. Flag Rotation: After the flag ownership time ends, the right to plant the flag will rotate to the other club, or the right to plant the flag can be rotated after <Highlight>successfully seizing the flag</>. 4. Defeating opponents or participating in defeating opponents will also grant points. 5. The entire war declaration will last for <Highlight>30 minutes</>. At the time of settlement, the party with the higher points wins. If the scores are the same, the party that was declared war on wins. 6. During the war declaration, you can use the <Highlight>"Assemble - Club War Declaration"</> item to <Highlight>initiate an assembly</> in the Hornacis Mountain Range. The item can be viewed in the Companion Shop - Club.

вЂ”In that world, no one sacrificed their life in the battle against Megose. The Cathedral subsequently gave the Nighthawks squad that guarded all of Tingen the opportunity to take up posts in Backlund, but Dunn and Frye both refused. 

      Daly returned from Backlund late at night; she brought a bottle of the wine that both Dunn and Frye loved, as was her custom. 
      "So, you really refused the Cathedral's invitation?" She leaned against the table, her gaze resting on Dunn's face. 
      Dunn looked up at her. The firelight flickered gently in his gray eyes. 
      "You are more suited for that place than I am," he said, his voice calm and heavy. "In Tingen, the people here know me, and I know every street, every window. I want to stay here and continue guarding it." 
      Frye silently poured himself a glass and raised it: "Me too." 
      Daly was silent for a moment, then laughed softly: "I knew you would say that." 
      She grabbed the bottle and filled her own glass. Three glasses clinked together in front of the fireplace with a crisp sound. 
      Outside the window, Tingen slept quietly under the watchful eyes of the sleepless Guardians.

When Baldwin Wetherell became a squire, he received an amulet. The person who rewarded him said: "The previous owner wore it and returned from the battlefield alive; I wish you the same luck." 
 He carried this amulet through countless battles, advancing all the way, and founded his own Goshawk Knights. He had been injured many times, but every time he fell, someone dragged him back, just as he had dragged many people back. 
 Later, Baldwin gifted this amulet to the most capable knight under his command. Later still, this amulet was passed from this knight to the next squire. Every knight who sent it away had great military achievements, and every knight who received it was still young. 
 When handing it over, they usually only said one sentence: "Come back alive." 
 The other replied: "You too." 
 So the two turned onto their horses and walked on different paths, until the dust raised by the horse's hooves blurred their eyes.
